answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 28814 Country: India Title: Respected pious scholar, I have 2-3 hairs white...which is better 1)no khidab(mehndi) 2)mehndi 3)mehndi oil? Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakatuhu! Respected pious scholar, I have 2-3 hairs white...which is better 1)no khidab(mehndi) 2)mehndi 3)mehndi oil? Answer ID: 28814 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 121/121/M=1432) It is allowed to apply dye in white hair other than black. It is better to dye with red henna. And it is no sin if someone does not apply dye. There is no need to apply dye only for two or three white hair. If you apply, it is not forbidden. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
